AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Reads and controls the user's Home Assistant smart home through the Terrazzo app's sign-in. Operational patterns: - Call 'findEntities' first to turn a device or room the user names into an entityId. - Use 'getEntityState' to answer questions such as whether a light is on or what a sensor reads. - 'turnOn' also runs scenes and scripts. Constraints: - Locks and alarm panels can be read but not switched; their canSwitch is false. - Switching functions return the state from before the call; Home Assistant updates it shortly after.
AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:displayDescription: Control your Home Assistant lights, switches and scenes
